## Purpose and service boundaries

Describe what this service owns and what it does not own.

## Normal operations

Startup, shutdown, deployment, and routine maintenance commands. Include only commands verified for the target environment.

## Health checks

Define liveness, readiness, dependency checks, and expected signals.

## Common failure modes

| Symptom | Likely cause | Safe diagnostic | Recovery |
|---|---|---|---|
| | | | |

## Data and recovery

Document backups, retention, restore steps, RPO/RTO targets, and escalation contacts. Do not invent targets.

## Security

Describe credential source, rotation path, access scope, and log redaction requirements.

## Escalation and change history

Record escalation path and changes to the runbook.
